seller_or_subject: Paid Partnership newsletter — Throwing Fits migration analysis
notes: Author Neil Tennant is an industry observer, not the Patreon creator in question. Edge case 2: third-party retelling of a creator's migration, not direct testimony from Throwing Fits.

extra_fields.subject: Third-party analyst reports Throwing Fits (men's fashion creators) migrated from Substack back to Patreon in September 2025 after a one-year stint; Patreon offered "a private launch dinner at one of NYC's hippest restaurants and a billboard in Times Square." Patreon hiring "Acquisition Manager" to court creators.
